q: By June 30, 2027, in connection with ceasefire or peace negotiations, the United States lifts its sanctions designations of Rosneft and Lukoil or submits to Congress a certification terminating the Russia sanctions under the U.S. Russia sanctions law (the Graham Act)
basis: The United States has put sanctions relief on the negotiating agenda and has licensed transactions in Russian diesel. But 69 percent of American adults favor tougher sanctions on Russia, and the new Congress will be able to block a termination certification within 30 days with a resolution of disapproval (the president can veto such a resolution). This forecast tests whether the United States shifts to its third-ranked course, inducing a ceasefire by leading with sanctions relief.
rs: Announcements by the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) and certifications submitted to Congress
